# Entry Gate Template

This is an optional Heavy/formal profile, not a default planning artifact or a
universal gate.

```markdown
Product outcome and authority:
Governance / permission:
Scope / non-goals / paths:
Acceptance and project-required checks:
Dependencies and mutable shared state:
Selected conditional profiles:
Human-only gates:
Stop conditions:
ACTIVE_CONTEXT reference / first next action:
```

Select only useful profiles: Graph, waves/lanes, separate controller/coder,
packets/structural gate, specialist adapters, project security/browser/data
checks, rollback for durable/public/migration/release change, or bounded
multi-milestone continuation.
